cli.description: gea — installer and orchestrator for AI coding agents
doctor.title: gea doctor — check only (installs nothing)
doctor.tool_shadcn_mcp: shadcn MCP server detected (use the CLI instead)
doctor.summary_missing: Missing {count} tool(s). Run `gea setup` to install them.
version.label: gea version {version}
uninstall.nothing: nothing recorded by `gea setup` — nothing to uninstall
secrets.blocked: commit blocked — mark false positives with `{marker}` or use --no-verify
lint.nothing: no AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or skills found to lint
undo.none: no checkpoint for {task_id} — `gea delegate` takes one before each run
undo.warning: gea undo {task_id} discards everything changed since the checkpoint:
auth.title: agent sessions
auth.no_tokens: {cli}: logged in, but out of tokens until {until}
auth.unknown: {cli}: session state unknown (no CLI command to check it)
review.none: no other agent available to review — review it yourself (gea review-pack)
delegate.stray: {count} file(s) touched outside the task's ## Files: {files}
delegate.gap: {task_id} is not self-sufficient — empty: {gap}; the builder must explore
delegate.no_agent: no builder agent available — implement it yourself or run `gea agents available`
delegate.budget: budget of {minutes} min exceeded — the builder pane was left running
verify.none: no verify commands configured — run `gea init` or edit gea.json
prune.none: no skills outside gea's list — nothing to prune
prune.header: {count} skill(s) not installed by gea (largest first):
delegate.worktree_failed: could not create the worktree — nothing was left behind
worktree.remove: Remove the worktree of {task_id} ({path}) and its merged branch?
worktree.remove_failed: could not remove the worktree at {path}
stats.header: agent          tier attempts  success     avg  timeouts
pr.confirm: Create this pull request on GitHub?
init.builders_hint: Builders are tried cheapest-first (priority order). Mark delicate tasks `Tier: L`, or pin agents per tier with builders.tiers in gea.json.
init.report_new: new project — gea will create the full structure
init.report_existing: existing project — gea adds around your files, never over them
init.report_agents_md: AGENTS.md found (~{tokens} tokens): kept as is, gea adds its own block
init.report_claude_md: CLAUDE.md found: kept as is, gea adds its own block
init.report_agents_dir: .agents/ found ({count} file(s)): only missing files are created
init.report_tasks: tasks in another format: {layout} — `gea task import` can convert them
init.warn_oversized: AGENTS.md is ~{tokens} tokens; the pre-commit lint fails above ~2000 — move detail into .agents/
init.warn_shadcn_mcp: shadcn MCP server in {location}: gea uses the shadcn CLI instead
import.forced_completed: {name}: was in completed/ with status '{status}' — set to completed
import.conflict: {name}: {path} already exists with different content — nothing imported
import.none: no tasks in a known layout found (tasks/active|completed, tasks/, docs/tasks)
import.remove_refused: --remove-source needs every imported file tracked by git and unmodified — nothing removed
import.remove_confirm: git rm the {count} original task file(s)?
init.offer_import: Import them into gea's task structure now?
delegate.closed: {pane}: pane closed (builders.close = "on-success"; set "never" in gea.json to keep it)
exhausted.agent: {agent} is out of quota (pool {pool}) until {until} — marked unavailable
exhausted.none: no other agent is available — implement it yourself or wait for the reset
delegate.yolo_needs_worktree: builders.permissions is "yolo" (no permission checks), which gea only allows inside a worktree — use `gea delegate --worktree` or set builders.worktrees: true
verify.interrupted: interrupted (130) while running `{command}` after {seconds}s.{typical} Run it again and do not cancel it: it prints a heartbeat while it works.
verify.waiting: another verify is running (pid {pid}), waiting for it…
agents.already_there: '{id}' is already a subagent of this project
agents.not_detected: '{id}' is not a detected profile — add it as a custom one (--cli)
agents.pick_model: Models {cli} reports (number, or type to filter):
agents.model_unknown: '{model}' is not in the list {cli} reports — kept anyway
agents.no_clis: no agent CLI is installed (claude, codex, opencode, agy, kimi)
agents.pool_note: Models on the same account share one quota, so they must share a pool (suggested: {pool})
agents.pick_planner: Planner CLI (the agent that plans and reviews)
agents.menu: [p] planner  [a] add  [m] change model  [r] remove  [o] priority  [q] save & quit  [x] quit without saving
agents.custom_option: + custom (another model of an installed CLI)
init.agents_hint: Change the planner, models or subagents any time with `gea agents manage`.
worktree.not_merged: branch {branch} is not merged into HEAD — worktree kept at {path}
worktree.hint_yes: worktree of {task_id} kept at {path} — run `gea task done {task_id} --yes` to remove it and its merged branch
delegate.start_failed: {task_id} stays planned and nothing was left behind (worktree, branch, pane). Fix the agent CLI (login, quota, daemon) or retry with `gea delegate {task_id} --agent <other>` — this is a startup failure, not a builder that finished empty.
delegate.no_changes: {task_id}: {agent} finished but changed nothing — verify was not run (it would pass vacuously). Check the pane, or retry / use --agent <other>.
delegate.main_touched: builder wrote {count} file(s) in the main checkout instead of its worktree: {files}
task.head_moved: HEAD moved from {before} to {after} while closing the task — gea does not move HEAD; check `git reflog` (another process may have reset the branch) and `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> HEAD` for what you merged
undo.head_moved: HEAD moved since the checkpoint of {task_id} (commits were made or merged); undo would reset them away. Review `git log`, or pass --force to reset anyway.
delegate.crashed: {task_id}: {agent} crashed (its CLI died mid-run, e.g. SIGILL) — worktree, branch and pane cleaned up; the task stays as it was.
delegate.watching: watching {task_id}: the orchestrator is notified when the builder finishes
